methods: Construct and charge a legal extra operation on a minimal instance.

original_card.acceptance_gate: State which fixed-alphabet premise changes and charge its implementation; do not declare it free. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

allowed_variations: Choose one additional operation and a small source count for its first counterexample.

Extending a source-count census without naming a supplier/interface decision it could change; audit #2973 pruning concerns before relying on the affected predecessor exclusions.

actual_scope: Exclude a covering ten-step five-source walk with one triple and nine singletons; deduce a 122 source-leaf lower bound for ten-step covering walks containing any step of arity at least three.
scope_change_reason: Take the explicit attainment question in unpaidmoon PR4137 rather than introduce an unpriced new operation. This is an exact finite obstruction in its already charged triple alphabet.
bottleneck_link: The result separates pair and higher-arity source calls at the minimum ten-step boundary: higher arity cannot tie the 120 source-leaf fixture bill. It does not admit a supplier or improve kappa.
stop_rule: Stop at the first exact exclusion, corroborate by an independent position-placement census, and package without searching a larger incidence class.
evidence: 120960 lexicographic words and 22680 independently placed representatives exclude complete coverage. The sharp mask maxima are 30 and 26 according to whether the triple contains the four-use source.
